messages:
marco-partnerships: Proposal: run a 90-day "Consumption Accelerator" pilot that blends an on-ramp credit with a time-limited committed ramp path. Target: cloud marketplace customers and ISVs bringing quick PoCs. Key questions: how to meter hybrid on-prem/cloud usage, renewal triggers, and seller incentives. Thoughts? :rocket:

leah-sales: Sounds good. Sales ask: can we make the committed ramp multi-step so reps can show clear milestones? e.g., 0-30d onboarding credit, 30-60d usage discount if X consumed, 60-90d commit conversion bonus. Keeps sellers engaged.

omar-ops: Metering complexity: hybrid usage needs normalized units. Ops suggests a normalized "CU" (consumption unit) per token or device-hour. Marketplace can accept a synthetic CU meter fed via partner or agent; we'll need mapping rules. Also recommend fraud detection flags for rapid burst consumption.

sophia-legal: Legal points: 1) define conversion window and what counts as "committed" (signed agreement + marketplace SKU lock), 2) outline clawback language for credits if discovered misuse, 3) state renewal mechanics and non-retroactivity. I'll share a draft clause.

ryan-finance: Quick economics back-of-envelope: assume avg_seed_credit=10k, conversion_rate=18% over 90d, avg_commit=60k ARR -> payback in ~9 months. Need to model churn uplift and invoice lag. Recommend credit cap per org and partner-level spend cap.

eng-marketplace: Implementation notes: add new offer template `consumption_accelerator_v1`. It will include fields: credit_amount, milestones [{day, cu_threshold, discount}], normalized_meter_name. ETA for listing+meter wiring ~8 business days. We can reuse existing reconciliation infra but will add CU normalization layer.

partner-success: From partner onboarding: provide a partner checklist: feed for CU events, contact person for reconciliation, and joint-sell collateral. Partners want predictable terms. Also ask to expose a customer-facing FAQ about how credits apply to invoices.

leah-sales: Commission mechanics: keep standard commission on new ARR but apply an override credit to sales-ops for tracking. propose a 3mo holdback on credit-incentive until commit verified to avoid gaming.

omar-ops: Ops will need to publish an API spec for synthetic CU events and a sample client. Also need an off-ramp plan if partner cannot deliver CU feeds (fallback to manual verification).

sophia-legal: Addendum for partners required stating they won't bundle credits across customer accounts. Also include an audit right clause and dispute resolution timeline.

ryan-finance: I'll prepare a sensitivity table for credit size vs conversion uplift and include worst-case scenario (0% conversion). Also propose a pilot cap of $150k total credits.

eng-marketplace: We'll also surface an "accelerator status" field on marketplace dashboard showing burn, milestones hit, and verification status. Small UI change but valuable for sellers. ETA 2 weeks if prioritized.

marco-partnerships: Action items: 1) @eng-marketplace open template PR + sample CU mapping (ETA Mon), 2) @sophia-legal draft addendum & clawback language (ETA Tue), 3) @ryan-finance run sensitivity + set pilot cap (ETA Tue), 4) @omar-ops publish CU event API + client sample (ETA Wed), 5) @leah-sales draft seller play and commission holdback note (ETA Wed), 6) @partner-success create partner onboarding checklist & FAQ (ETA Wed). Target pilot launch mid-next-month if all green. :calendar:

leah-sales: I'll recruit 2 ISVs and 1 cloud reseller to try this. Will share outreach email once we have the one-pager.

partner-success: I'll prep a partner kickoff template and schedule the enablement call.

marco-partnerships: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene next week with drafts. :handshake:
